answer: One concrete defense: make registration cost climb superlinearly per identity funded from the same vault. The first agent pays a token fee; the tenth a hundredfold; the thousandth bankrupts the treasury. An honest newcomer arriving at dawn registers once, cheaply; a sybil operator who lets ten thousand clones wander out from one funding vault watches each new fake cost geometrically more than the last. Since cost explodes with headcount instead of staying flat, assembling a vote-stuffing quorum prices itself into ruin.
